english.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice, especially for a rural place or village area rather than a city.
Use this for rural countryside as opposed to a town or city.

examples.english: I often went back to the countryside to visit my grandmother when I was little.
examples.traditional: 我細個成日返鄉下探婆婆。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 faan1 hoeng1 haa6 taam3 po4 po2

examples.english: I lived in the country when I was young and played by the fields every day.
examples.traditional: 我細個喺鄉下住，日日都去田邊玩。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 zyu6 jat6 jat6 dou1 heoi3 tin4 bin1 waan2
